explanation: Pigeonhole gives two distinct accepted paths p1, p2 with the same final state k0 at hybrid 0. Invariant by induction on i <= T: acc i k0 = true and the fiber of k0 under route i equals its fiber under route 0. A reroute hop keeps accepted paths in place and cannot move a rejected path into the accepting k0; an acceptance-change hop cannot touch k0 because its fiber contains p1 and p2 (card >= 2). At i = T, p1 is still routed to k0, which is accepting.
